target: Resolve remaining broken, blocked, unknown, dirty, and owner-ambiguous branch/worktree survivors after safe archive cleanup phase 2.
invariants: Do not delete any local or remote branch without current graph proof.
Do not force-delete blocked branches unless a separate proof step establishes supersession or disposal safety.
Do not modify runtime code, service code, or production configs.
Treat broken temp worktrees, owner-ambiguous survivors, dirty state, and closed-unmerged PR heads as separate classes.
Every destructive recommendation must be evidence-backed and reproducible.
Open PR branches and active review branches must be preserved unless explicitly superseded by current authority.

commit.message: docs(repo-hygiene): resolve broken and ambiguous survivors after phase 2

pr.title: docs(repo-hygiene): resolve blocked and ambiguous cleanup survivors
pr.body:
## Summary
- re-audit blocked local branches, broken temp worktrees, unknown survivors, dirty survivors, and owner-ambiguous survivors after phase 2
- classify each item with current graph proof and current PR authority
- execute only those cleanup actions newly proven safe in this phase

## Scope
- docs, proof, and task-packet outputs only unless specific cleanup actions are executed and recorded in proof
- no runtime code changes
- no remote branch deletion unless explicitly proven safe and within packet scope

## Validation
- current git graph, worktree, branch tracking, and PR state refreshed
- proof JSON matches executed actions and preserved survivors
- all unresolved items remain explicitly classified

## Follow-up
Additional cleanup, if any, will be packetized separately.

steps.task: Refresh current authority for all unresolved survivors from phases 1 and 2.
requirements: Re-check open PRs, closed-unmerged PR heads, current branch graph, and worktree inventory.
Explicitly revisit broken temp worktrees pr/467 and pr/480.
Reconfirm status of blocked branches: tp/rte-full-run-hygiene-and-launch-readiness, codex/rte-seam-extraction-foundation-v2, tp/gh-review-thread-agent.
validation: Current authority is refreshed rather than inherited blindly from prior packets.
Broken and blocked survivors are individually classified.

steps.task: Determine whether each blocked or ambiguous survivor is keep, merge-first, archive, broken-prunable, owner-ambiguous, or delete-safe.
requirements: Use current graph proof and current PR authority for every recommendation.
Do not collapse unknown and owner-ambiguous into delete-safe.
Do not promote blocked branches to deletion without explicit ancestor or supersession proof.
validation: Every survivor has explicit class, reason, and action.
No destructive action occurs without proof.

steps.task: Execute only newly proven-safe cleanup actions and record exact command results.
requirements: Record every attempted cleanup command and exit code.
Preserve any item that fails proof or deletion safety checks.
Do not use force deletion unless explicitly authorized by proof and packet scope.

steps.task: Publish the phase 3 cleanup record and open a PR.
requirements: Write the phase 3 report and proof.
Open a PR with only packet/report/proof surfaces unless cleanup commands required tracked metadata changes.
